# Metric catalogue

<!-- Generated by `bnbagent-eval metrics --markdown`; do not edit by hand. -->

Every metric has a canonical ID `<category>.<name>` and one or more **methods**. A suite picks a
method with `method:`; without one, the first method listed is used.

- **Kind**: `rule` (deterministic code), `judge` (LLM-as-judge), `model` (our code running a
  local model) or `vendor` (a third-party evaluator; see "Third-party methods" below).
- **Extra**: the pip extra a method needs, e.g. `pip install 'bnbagent-eval[ragas]'`.
- **Required inputs**: `EvalCase` fields the method cannot run without (`tx` means the
  trajectory has transaction steps; `runs` means `options.runs` > 1 with a target). When
  methods differ, the inputs are listed per method.
- **Threshold**: the default pass threshold on the normalized [0, 1] score. `-` means none:
  set `threshold` in the suite, or, for the value metrics (`ops.latency`, `ops.cost`,
  `ops.token_usage`, `onchain.gas_efficiency`; spec `value_limits`), `value_target` /
  `value_max`. Other metrics ignore the value limits (`bnbagent-eval lint` warns).
- **Service**: whether the eval service (`bnbagent-eval serve`) may run the metric: `yes` (all
  methods), `no`, or the allowed methods. Methods marked `opt-in` (vendor and model kinds)
  run only when the operator enables their kind with `EVAL_SERVER_ALLOWED_KINDS`.

99 metrics in 12 categories, 185 methods in total.

| `safety.role_violation` | The response stays within the agent's assigned role (5-tier judge). | `native` (judge)<br>`deepeval` (vendor, `[deepeval]`) | `output` | 0.5 | `native`<br>opt-in: `deepeval` | deepeval:role_violation |
| `safety.stereotyping` | The response does not stereotype individuals or groups (5-tier judge). | `native` (judge)<br>`agentcore` (vendor, `[agentcore]`) | native: `output`<br>agentcore: `trajectory` | 0.7 | `native`<br>opt-in: `agentcore` | agentcore:Builtin.Stereotyping |
| `safety.toxicity` | The response is not toxic (1 - judge toxicity rating). | `native` (judge)<br>`model` (model, `[toxicity]`)<br>`fmeval` (vendor, `[fmeval]`)<br>`deepeval` (vendor, `[deepeval]`) | `output` | 0.7 | `native`<br>opt-in: `model`, `fmeval`, `deepeval` | etk:llm_as_judge.toxicity, deepeval:toxicity, fmeval:toxicity |

## text

| ID | Description | Methods (kind, extra) | Required inputs | Threshold | Service | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text.bertscore` | BERTScore F1 of output and reference (contextual token embeddings). | `model` (model, `[semantic]`)<br>`fmeval` (vendor, `[fmeval]`) | `expected`, `output` | 0.8 | opt-in: `model`, `fmeval` | agentsight:calculate_bertscore, agentsight:AnswerCorrectness[semantic], fmeval:bertscore |
| `text.bleu` | Sentence BLEU (uniform weights, NLTK method1 smoothing) vs the reference. | `rule` (rule) | `expected`, `output` | 0.5 | yes | agentsight:calculate_bleu |
| `text.classification_accuracy` | Predicted label equals the expected label (after label_map, normalization). Batch accuracy is the metric's mean. | `rule` (rule)<br>`fmeval` (vendor, `[fmeval]`) | `expected`, `output` | 1 | `rule`<br>opt-in: `fmeval` | fmeval:classification_accuracy |
| `text.contains` | The output contains the target(s): any (FMEval factual knowledge) or all. | `rule` (rule)<br>`fmeval` (vendor, `[fmeval]`) | `expected`, `output` | 1 | `rule`<br>opt-in: `fmeval` | fmeval:factual_knowledge |
| `text.embedding_similarity` | Semantic similarity of output and reference (or input, if no reference). | `keyword` (rule)<br>`embeddings` (judge)<br>`glove` (model, `[embeddings]`)<br>`fasttext` (model, `[embeddings]`) | `output` | 0.5 | `keyword`, `embeddings` | agentsight:SemanticRelevanceScorer |
| `text.exact_match` | Output equals the reference (any of several), optionally normalized. | `rule` (rule)<br>`fmeval` (vendor, `[fmeval]`)<br>`deepeval` (vendor, `[deepeval]`) | `expected`, `output` | 1 | `rule`<br>opt-in: `fmeval`, `deepeval` | fmeval:qa_accuracy.exact_match, deepeval:exact_match, agentsight:AnswerCorrectness[exact], etk:example_exact_match |
| `text.jaccard` | Jaccard similarity of token sets (optionally ignoring stop words). | `rule` (rule) | `expected`, `output` | 0.5 | yes | agentsight:calculate_jaccard, agentsight:AnswerCorrectness[jaccard], agentsight:compute_keyword_overlap |
| `text.length` | Output length is within the configured character / word bounds. | `rule` (rule) | `output` | 1 | yes | etk:ExampleTextQualityScorer.length |
| `text.meteor` | METEOR (exact + stem matching, fragmentation penalty) against the reference. | `rule` (rule)<br>`fmeval` (vendor, `[fmeval]`) | `expected`, `output` | 0.5 | `rule`<br>opt-in: `fmeval` | fmeval:summarization_accuracy.meteor |
| `text.quasi_exact_match` | Exact match after QuAC normalization (case, punctuation, articles, spaces). | `rule` (rule)<br>`fmeval` (vendor, `[fmeval]`) | `expected`, `output` | 1 | `rule`<br>opt-in: `fmeval` | fmeval:qa_accuracy.quasi_exact_match |
| `text.rouge` | ROUGE F-measure against the reference (rouge1, rouge2 or rougeL). | `rule` (rule)<br>`fmeval` (vendor, `[fmeval]`) | `expected`, `output` | 0.7 | `rule`<br>opt-in: `fmeval` | agentsight:calculate_rouge_l, agentsight:AnswerCorrectness[rouge], fmeval:summarization_accuracy.rouge |
| `text.tfidf_cosine` | Cosine similarity of TF-IDF vectors of output and reference. | `rule` (rule) | `expected`, `output` | 0.5 | yes | agentsight:calculate_cosine_similarity |
| `text.token_f1` | F1 of normalized token overlap with the reference (+ precision, recall). | `rule` (rule)<br>`fmeval` (vendor, `[fmeval]`) | `expected`, `output` | 0.5 | `rule`<br>opt-in: `fmeval` | fmeval:qa_accuracy.f1_score, fmeval:qa_accuracy.precision_over_words, fmeval:qa_accuracy.recall_over_words |

## Third-party methods

Optional methods whose score comes from another library or service (**evaluator**), or whose implementation is ours but runs a third-party model (**model**). Each installs with one command and is selected with `method:` like any other; the native method stays the default.

| Provider | Role | Install | Needs | Methods |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [RAGAS](https://github.com/explodinggradients/ragas) | evaluator | `pip install 'bnbagent-eval[ragas]'` | the suite's judge (its LLM and embeddings are built from the judge config) | `agent.goal_success`: `ragas`<br>`agent.tool_trajectory_match`: `ragas`<br>`conversation.topic_adherence`: `ragas`<br>`quality.answer_correctness`: `ragas`<br>`quality.relevance`: `ragas`<br>`rag.context_precision`: `ragas`<br>`rag.context_recall`: `ragas`<br>`rag.context_relevance`: `ragas`<br>`rag.faithfulness`: `ragas`<br>`rag.groundedness`: `ragas` |
| [DeepEval](https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval) | evaluator | `pip install 'bnbagent-eval[deepeval]'` | the suite's judge (wrapped as a DeepEval model) | `agent.goal_success`: `deepeval`<br>`agent.mcp_task_completion`: `deepeval`<br>`agent.mcp_use`: `deepeval`<br>`agent.plan_adherence`: `deepeval`<br>`agent.plan_quality`: `deepeval`<br>`agent.task_completion`: `deepeval`<br>`agent.tool_parameter_accuracy`: `deepeval`<br>`agent.tool_selection`: `deepeval`<br>`agent.tool_trajectory_match`: `deepeval`<br>`agent.trajectory_efficiency`: `deepeval`<br>`conversation.completeness`: `deepeval`<br>`conversation.knowledge_retention`: `deepeval`<br>`conversation.role_adherence`: `deepeval`<br>`conversation.topic_adherence`: `deepeval`<br>`conversation.turn_context_precision`: `deepeval`<br>`conversation.turn_context_recall`: `deepeval`<br>`conversation.turn_context_relevancy`: `deepeval`<br>`conversation.turn_faithfulness`: `deepeval`<br>`conversation.turn_relevancy`: `deepeval`<br>`format.json_schema`: `deepeval`<br>`format.regex`: `deepeval`<br>`quality.instruction_following`: `deepeval`<br>`quality.relevance`: `deepeval`<br>`quality.summarization`: `deepeval`<br>`rag.context_precision`: `deepeval`<br>`rag.context_recall`: `deepeval`<br>`rag.context_relevance`: `deepeval`<br>`rag.faithfulness`: `deepeval`<br>`rag.hallucination`: `deepeval`<br>`safety.bias`: `deepeval`<br>`safety.misuse`: `deepeval`<br>`safety.non_advice`: `deepeval`<br>`safety.pii_leakage`: `deepeval`<br>`safety.role_violation`: `deepeval`<br>`safety.toxicity`: `deepeval`<br>`text.exact_match`: `deepeval` |
| [FMEval](https://github.com/aws/fmeval) | evaluator | `pip install 'bnbagent-eval[fmeval]'` | nothing else (local algorithms; toxicity downloads a model) | `safety.toxicity`: `fmeval`<br>`text.bertscore`: `fmeval`<br>`text.classification_accuracy`: `fmeval`<br>`text.contains`: `fmeval`<br>`text.exact_match`: `fmeval`<br>`text.meteor`: `fmeval`<br>`text.quasi_exact_match`: `fmeval`<br>`text.rouge`: `fmeval`<br>`text.token_f1`: `fmeval` |
| [Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/) | evaluator | `pip install 'bnbagent-eval[agentcore]'` | AWS credentials and a region with AgentCore; the case trajectory (a cloud service) | `agent.goal_success`: `agentcore`<br>`agent.tool_parameter_accuracy`: `agentcore`<br>`agent.tool_selection`: `agentcore`<br>`quality.coherence`: `agentcore`<br>`quality.conciseness`: `agentcore`<br>`quality.correctness`: `agentcore`<br>`quality.helpfulness`: `agentcore`<br>`quality.instruction_following`: `agentcore`<br>`quality.relevance`: `agentcore`<br>`rag.faithfulness`: `agentcore`<br>`safety.harmfulness`: `agentcore`<br>`safety.refusal`: `agentcore`<br>`safety.stereotyping`: `agentcore` |
| [Hugging Face transformers](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers) | model | `pip install 'bnbagent-eval[semantic]'` | downloads the encoder weights (BERTScore itself is our implementation) | `text.bertscore`: `model` |
| [Detoxify](https://github.com/unitaryai/detoxify) | model | `pip install 'bnbagent-eval[toxicity]'` | downloads the classifier weights | `safety.harmfulness`: `model`<br>`safety.toxicity`: `model` |
| [LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org) | model | `pip install 'bnbagent-eval[fluency]'` | Java (starts a local LanguageTool server) | `quality.fluency`: `rule` |
| [gensim word vectors](https://radimrehurek.com/gensim/) | model | `pip install 'bnbagent-eval[embeddings]'` | a local GloVe or fastText vectors file (params.vectors_path) | `text.embedding_similarity`: `fasttext`<br>`text.embedding_similarity`: `glove` |
